cues.en: Hello and welcome back.
cues.zh: 你好，歡迎回來。

cues.en: Today we talk about machine learning paradigms.
cues.zh: 今天談機器學習範式。

cues.en: Now paradigms are unique ways for a machine or a model to learn.
cues.zh: 範式就是機器或模型獨特的學習方式。

cues.en: And there's three main ones of them in machine learning and you need to know them for the exam.
cues.zh: 機器學習有三種主要範式，考試需要知道。

cues.en: The first one is supervised learning.
cues.zh: 第一，監督式學習。

cues.en: For example, regression and classification, both of those fall under supervised learning.
cues.zh: 例如迴歸與分類，都屬於監督式學習。

cues.en: And here we can see a beautiful image of people supervising a machine.
cues.zh: 這裡有張漂亮圖片，人們在監督機器。

cues.en: And how do you supervise a machine?
cues.zh: 如何監督機器？

cues.en: Well, what you do is you provide input data with labels.
cues.zh: 提供有標籤的輸入資料。

cues.en: In this case you've got input data with annotations, these are apples.
cues.zh: 這個例子是附有註記的輸入資料：這些是蘋果。

cues.en: But it might be, for example, data about patients with lots of information like their blood test results, their weight, their smoking history,
cues.zh: 也可能是病患資料，包含很多資訊，例如血液檢查結果、體重、吸菸史、

cues.en: family history and so on, lots of columns for input data.
cues.zh: 家族史等等，很多欄輸入資料。

cues.en: And then the annotation or the label is whether or not they have a diabetes.
cues.zh: 註記或標籤則是有沒有糖尿病。

cues.en: So basically, you're giving the machine examples of past observations with answers.
cues.zh: 基本上，提供機器過去觀測資料與答案作為範例。

cues.en: Each one of those observations has an answer to learn from.
cues.zh: 每筆觀測資料都有答案，能從中學習。

cues.en: And so the model then digest this.
cues.zh: 模型消化這些資料。

cues.en: And then next time you give it an example of an image or you give it an example of a patient's like columns of the same information, like a new patient.
cues.zh: 下次再給一張影像，或同樣資訊欄位的病患資料，例如一位新病患，

cues.en: You give them their weight, their smoking history, their family history and so on.
cues.zh: 提供體重、吸菸史、家族史等。

cues.en: And then the model will be able to, from that predict what the answer for that new observation is.
cues.zh: 模型就能預測新觀測資料的答案。

cues.en: But again, the main thing here is that the input data already had those answers for each row or each observation or apples or whatever it was
cues.zh: 重點是，原本每列、每筆觀測資料、每個蘋果等輸入，都已附有答案，

cues.en: for the model to learn from.
cues.zh: 讓模型學習。

cues.en: That's the supervision, the supervision is providing the answer during training.
cues.zh: 這就是監督，訓練時提供答案。

cues.en: Now, unsupervised learning, for example, clustering falls into this category, is when you provide data without any answers attached to that data.
cues.zh: 非監督式學習，例如分群，則提供沒有附帶答案的資料。

cues.en: So you just give it lots of data.
cues.zh: 只給大量資料。

cues.en: You, for example, you give it, it could be lots of patient data with their smoking history, their weight, their family history and so on.
cues.zh: 例如大量病患的吸菸史、體重、家族史等等。

cues.en: But no answer, yes or no, do they have diabetes?
cues.zh: 但沒有是否罹患糖尿病的答案。

cues.en: Or you could give it lots of images of different fruit, but no labels.
cues.zh: 也可以給不同水果的大量影像，但沒有標籤。

cues.en: What is a banana?
cues.zh: 哪個是香蕉？

cues.en: What is an apple?
cues.zh: 哪個是蘋果？

cues.en: What is a pear or a peach in this case?
cues.zh: 哪個是梨，或這裡的桃子？

cues.en: You just give it all that data and it has to figure out on its own how do they group?
cues.zh: 只提供資料，讓它自行找出如何分組。

cues.en: So how do they cluster together?
cues.zh: 如何分成群集？

cues.en: So it would cluster all the apples together, 'cause they kind of look similar.
cues.zh: 會把所有蘋果放一起，因為外觀相似。

cues.en: All the peaches look similar, all the bananas look similar.
cues.zh: 桃子彼此相似，香蕉彼此相似。

cues.en: So it'd be able to cluster 'em similarly with patients.
cues.zh: 因此能分群，病患也類似。

cues.en: It wouldn't know which patients have diabetes or not, but based on the inputs it would be able to cluster them together.
cues.zh: 不知道誰有糖尿病，但根據輸入，可以將病患分組。

cues.en: And you might find groups of patients.
cues.zh: 可能會找出不同病患群。

cues.en: And this is very useful when you're exploring new data that you haven't seen before.
cues.zh: 探索沒看過的新資料時，這很有用。

cues.en: For example, you have customers in your business, you have information about their purchasing patterns, but you don't know how to group them.
cues.zh: 例如企業有顧客購買模式資訊，但不知道如何分組。

cues.en: You don't have specific ideas on how to group them.
cues.zh: 沒有特定分組想法。

cues.en: Well, unsupervised learning can help you determine that grouping, those clusters.
cues.zh: 非監督式學習能協助找出分組、群集。

cues.en: And reinforcement learning is the third type.
cues.zh: 第三種是強化學習。

cues.en: And here, what we do is you give model rewards and punishments, quote unquote rewards and punishments,
cues.zh: 這裡提供模型所謂獎勵與懲罰，

cues.en: basically feedback for the actions it takes.
cues.zh: 基本上是對它所採取動作的回饋。

cues.en: So here's an example let's say you have labyrinth and the agent or the game starts with the player, in this case the machine learning agent
cues.zh: 例如有個迷宮，智能體或遊戲的玩家，也就是機器學習智能體，

cues.en: being in that corner.
cues.zh: 一開始在這個角落。

cues.en: And they need to get to the flags and avoid the fire at all costs.
cues.zh: 需要到旗子的位置，而且一定要避開火。

cues.en: So if the agent moves into the fire, this type of training would give them a penalty of minus 100,
cues.zh: 如果智能體走進火裡，就給 -100 的懲罰，

cues.en: just minus 100 units of reward.
cues.zh: 也就是減少 100 單位獎勵。

cues.en: It's basically, just a number coded into a variable.
cues.zh: 基本上只是變數裡編碼的一個數字。

cues.en: But the agent is trying to optimize to get the highest reward.
cues.zh: 但智能體會嘗試將獎勵最大化。

cues.en: So they have taken into actions in this environment and they need to optimize to get the highest reward.
cues.zh: 在環境中採取動作，設法得到最高獎勵。

cues.en: So they would learn not to go into the fire very quickly, because their reward is being diminished by a hundred every time they do that.
cues.zh: 很快就會學會不走進火，因為每次都損失 100 獎勵。

cues.en: If they make a successful step, they get a plus one, plus one, plus one, they would get a plus one going here, but here they'd get a plus 100, right?
cues.zh: 成功走一步得到 +1、+1、+1，走這裡也是 +1，但這裡會得到 +100。

cues.en: So basically, this through trial and error, the agent would play this game many, many, many times and eventually they would figure out which way is the best way to go,
cues.zh: 透過試誤，智能體會反覆玩很多次，最後找出最佳走法，

cues.en: how do they maximize their reward?
cues.zh: 也就是如何最大化獎勵。

cues.en: So they don't really know about the flags or the fire like that.
cues.zh: 它不是真的理解旗子或火。

cues.en: Those are all things that we know about.
cues.zh: 那是我們理解的事物。

cues.en: They just know about their reward.
cues.zh: 它只知道獎勵。

cues.en: They wanna maximize their reward.
cues.zh: 希望最大化獎勵。

cues.en: This is how, for example, self-driving cars are trained.
cues.zh: 例如自駕車也可以這樣訓練。

cues.en: They are trained through reinforcement learning where they for example, they need to stay in the same lane all the time.
cues.zh: 用強化學習，例如要求一直保持在同一車道。

cues.en: If they get out of the lane, then they get a negative reward.
cues.zh: 偏離車道就有負獎勵。

cues.en: If they stay in the lane, the longer they stay in the lane, the more they get reward.
cues.zh: 留在車道裡，時間越長，獎勵越多。

cues.en: So they learn to keep staying in the lane to maximize their reward.
cues.zh: 於是學會維持在車道，以最大化獎勵。

cues.en: And that's how we get them to get to the destination.
cues.zh: 這就是讓它到目的地的方法。

cues.en: They don't really think about the destination, they think about maximizing their reward.
cues.zh: 它不是真的思考目的地，而是最大化獎勵。

cues.en: So that's reinforcement learning.
cues.zh: 這就是強化學習。

cues.en: So those are the three types of learning.
cues.zh: 以上三種學習方式。

cues.en: That's all you need to know for the exam.
cues.zh: 考試知道這些就足夠。

cues.en: You don't need to know the details, just remember the three different types, what they are and some examples.
cues.zh: 不需要細節，只記得三種分別是什麼，以及一些例子。

cues.en: And I've put some examples here in the text for this slide.
cues.zh: 這張投影片文字裡也放了例子。

cues.en: And there we go.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: Hope you enjoyed this and I look forward to seeing you back here next time.
cues.zh: 希望你喜歡，期待下次見。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy the cloud.
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受雲端的樂趣吧。
